provider: Epic Online Services Player Data Storage

free_tier.stated: 400 MB total storage space per user, 200 MB maximum individual file size, 1000 files per user
free_tier.notes: Headline offer; binding constraint specified in limits.

per_object_cap.stated: Maximum individual file size 200 MB; maximum files per user 1000
per_object_cap.notes: Maximum individual file size 200 MB; auto-delete file size 400 MB; total storage space per user 400 MB; maximum files per user 1000

retention.stated: Files that exceed the auto-delete file size are deleted following the upload.
retention.notes: the auto-delete file size is 400 MB

egress.terms: No per-GB egress meter documented for Player Data Storage; access is metered as API requests. EOS itself is free for all developers.

tooling: EOS SDK (C/C++), C# and Unreal plugins (PlayEveryWare/eos_plugin_for_unity). File ops are chunked read/write callbacks: EOS_PlayerDataStorage_WriteFile / ReadFile / QueryFileList. No rclone backend.
chaining: 400 MB per ProductUserId x unlimited free player identities. EOS supports anonymous/device auth, so identities are mintable at will; each new ProductUserId is a fresh 400 MB bucket. 2,500 identities = 1 TB.
limits_note: per-object-cap: 200 MB maximum individual file size; request-rate: 1000 read or write requests per minute; per-object-cap: 1000 files per user

extras.quota_verbatim: 400 MB total storage per user, 200 MB maximum per file, 1,000 files per user. No published product-level or title-level byte cap.
extras.limits_verbatim: per-object-cap: 200 MB per file and 64-character filename limit; request-rate: ~1,000 read or write requests per minute per user, then EOS_PlayerDataStorage_UserThrottled; per-object-cap: 1,000 files per user. Retention: none stated — files persist until explicitly deleted; no expiry found. Data is encrypted at rest with a client-side key EOS never stores, so losing the key loses the bytes.
extras.egress_verbatim: No per-GB egress meter documented for Player Data Storage; access is metered as API requests. EOS itself is free for all developers.
extras.chaining_verbatim: 400 MB per ProductUserId x unlimited free player identities. EOS supports anonymous/device auth, so identities are mintable at will; each new ProductUserId is a fresh 400 MB bucket. 2,500 identities = 1 TB.
extras.tooling_verbatim: EOS SDK (C/C++), C# and Unreal plugins (PlayEveryWare/eos_plugin_for_unity). File ops are chunked read/write callbacks: EOS_PlayerDataStorage_WriteFile / ReadFile / QueryFileList. No rclone backend.
extras.agent_focus: game platforms as storage: cloud saves, game backends, mod hosting. Per-user total caps and whether save data is retrievable via API.

binding_note: the per-object cap sets the shard size and therefore the object count; it bounds the total more tightly than any headline quota
